units.summary: Test constructs a two-step breaker instead of the one-step breaker so it matches the new groupBreaker type. Test-only type swap; same settings.
units.headline: Test now builds a two-step breaker
units.reason: Test-only constructor swap to match the new breaker type, with unchanged settings and assertions.

units.summary: Test constructs a two-step breaker instead of the one-step breaker so it matches the new groupBreaker type. Test-only type swap; same settings.
units.headline: Test now builds a two-step breaker
units.reason: Test-only constructor swap to match the new breaker type, with unchanged settings and assertions.

units.summary: handlerEntry now holds the two-step groupBreaker and a per-handler watches context with its cancel func. Reconcile uses the cancel to end watches when the handler is replaced or removed.
units.headline: handlerEntry gains per-handler watch context and two-step breaker
units.reason: Adds fields that carry lifecycle and cancellation state for long-lived watches, and changes the breaker type.
focus: every handlerEntry construction site goes through newHandlerEntry so endWatches is never nil
the breaker type change is compatible with all users

units.summary: New constructor builds a handlerEntry with a fresh breaker and a cancelable watches context. Reconcile now uses it for both new and changed groups.
units.headline: New constructor creates entry with cancelable watch context
units.reason: Creates a context per handler whose cancellation controls watch lifetime, so a leak or missed cancel changes runtime behavior.
focus: the cancel func is always called when the entry is retired, or the context leaks
the context is rooted at Background, not the reconcile ctx

units.summary: servingEntry now carries the groupBreaker type and the handler's watches context, so the serving path can scope watches to the handler.
units.headline: servingEntry carries watch context and new breaker type
units.reason: Adds a field the request path uses to end watches, and changes the breaker type used on every request.
focus: watches is set for every servingEntry that serves requests
the snapshot copy holds a context that outlives the entry only until cancel

units.summary: Router creates a router-wide cancelable watches context at construction. closeWatches uses it to end all watches at shutdown.
units.headline: Router creates a router-wide watch context
units.reason: Introduces the shutdown-level cancellation that terminates every in-flight watch.
focus: endWatches is called on every shutdown path
test routers built without NewGrafanaRouter leave watches nil

units.summary: A changed key now replaces the handlerEntry with a new one instead of mutating it in place. Replaced and removed entries are collected and their watches ended after publish, so clients re-watch the new backend.
units.headline: Reconcile replaces changed entries and ends their watches after publish
units.reason: Changes how handler swaps happen and terminates long-lived client streams on backend change or removal.
focus: ending watches happens after publish and outside any lock the watch handlers take
an unchanged key still keeps the same entry and its watches
early error or continue paths do not skip retiring entries

units.summary: publish copies each entry's watches context into the servingEntry snapshot so request handling can bind watches to the current handler.
units.headline: Snapshot now carries each entry's watch context
units.reason: Wires the watch lifetime into the snapshot read on every request.
focus: entries built by tests or other paths with nil watches are handled by serveWatch
